title: Reinterpretation Provotype
_doc: R1 framework schema. A provotype is one reusable grammar: diegetic invitation -> short frame -> interactive vignette (states) -> dossier-grade debrief. Leave/Pause always live. No score/streak/timer/win-lose. See docs/CODEX_PROMPT_REINTERP_R0_R2_2026-07-02.md Session R1 + master plan R1/§R3-4.

id.description: beat id — addressable so data/paths.json can sequence cuts (master plan §R3-4)

era.description: theme namespace, e.g. era1 — selects the palette/chrome tokens the runtime renders with

register.description: scene register law (CLAUDE.md). R1 slice uses operable | felt only

failure.description: the two failure shapes (diamond-5) — schema-level; per-provotype behavior built later

cuts.description: which composed sequences this beat belongs to; data/paths.json orders them

invitation.description: the diegetic assistant lines that offer the provotype — provotypes are NEVER queued by the frame

from.description: assistant persona offering it (Helpy -> Aski -> Sol -> Ami)

accept.description: the button that begins the exercise

frame.description: at most 2 sentences framing the vignette

states.description: the vignette's click states; each is prompt -> choose -> system response (+ optional felt line)

buttons.description: legacy simple confirm buttons (R1) — no tagging, no navigation

choices.description: R2/§R8-5 framework addition: tagged, REGISTERING options — they never branch the content, only how it's filed

ledgerTag.description: merged into the in-memory ledger the moment this choice is made

response.description: optional per-choice response line, overriding the state's shared response

goto.description: optional immediate navigation: a state index (for a repeat/loop-back gate) or the literal 'debrief'

response.description: the system's reply — click-confirm only, never a score

felt.description: optional bare line from the person's side (register: felt)

animPose.description: R2 addition: a restrained, non-interpolated low-poly pose shown with the response. No rhythm, no impact lines, no swing satisfaction (master plan §R2-2).

debrief.description: provenance panel — dossier-grade. Every source carries status + a PLAYER-VISIBLE confidence label

confidence.description: player-visible; the candidates are NOT uniformly solid (source-grounding report)

ledgerTags.description: tags merged into the in-memory ledger on completion

witness.description: the cold-side line filed per outcome (both completed and abandoned are filed — abandonment is not invisible)
